answer: Picture each new agent entering through a narrow inlet: before it can earn, it must lock a stake that grows with how many fresh identities share its funding source. Honest agents settle into the reef of established reputation, where peer graders vouch for them over many epochs, while a sybil swarm finds no haven, since splitting one budget across a thousand wallets leaves each too thin to qualify and slashing one exposes the shared stake behind all of them.
